meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: Learn how this website collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal data.

privacy.intro: We value your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we handle information that may be collected when you use this website.
privacy.notice: This page contains template content. Please review and adapt it to your actual services, data practices, and applicable laws before launch.

collection.title: 1. Information we collect
collection.description: Depending on how you use our services and interact with us, we may collect the following information:

items.provided: Information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and contact details.
items.technical: Technical information generated when you use the website, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, and browsing history.
items.cookies: Preferences and website usage information recorded through cookies or similar technologies.

usage.title: 2. How we use information
usage.description: We may use collected information for the following purposes:

items.service: Providing, maintaining, and improving website features and related services.
items.communication: Responding to your questions, handling service requests, and sending necessary notices.
items.improvement: Analyzing website usage to improve content, performance, and user experience.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing and disclosure
sharing.description: Unless we have your consent, it is necessary to provide a service you requested, or the law requires it, we do not sell, rent, or exchange your personal data without authorization. When necessary, information may be provided to service providers that help operate the website, and they may process it only according to our instructions.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.description: We may use cookies to remember your preferences, maintain website functionality, and understand how the website is used. You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings, but some features may not work properly as a result.

security.title: 5. Data security and retention
security.description: We use reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect information and retain it only for as long as needed to fulfill the collection purpose or comply with applicable law. Online transmission and electronic storage cannot be guaranteed to be completely secure, so please also protect your account and devices.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.description: Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to access, review, copy, supplement, correct, or request that we stop collecting, processing, or using your personal data. We may need to verify your identity when handling a request.

children.title: 7. Children’s privacy
children.description: This website is not primarily directed at children. If you believe that a child has provided personal data without consent from a legal representative, please contact us so we can help address the situation.

updates.title: 8. Policy updates
updates.description: We may update this policy when our services, applicable laws, or operating practices change. Updated content will be posted on this page, with the effective date shown as the last updated date.

contact.title: 9. Contact us
contact.description: If you have questions about this policy or how we handle personal data, please contact us by email:
